content: If someone wanted to see how far Lean 4 and modern AI tools could go with fluid dynamics and the Navier–Stokes equations, where does Mathlib currently stand with the required analysis tools, and are there simpler milestone papers or theorems in that area that would make sense as a realistic starting point?
Could a semi-automated workflow work here, and if so, exactly how?

Hi @Dan, not related to your exact question, but might be interested in a this thread: #Physlib > Good candidates for PhyslibAlpha. Where one of the themes is, what would be good candidates for things (with the help of AI) to attempt in PhyslibAlpha (which is the more-AI-friendly side of Physlib). We also have some fluid dynamics in Physlib.
